visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Kernighan's Trick
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The number is turned into a string of '0' and '1' characters and then those are counted. Use n &= n - 1, which clears the lowest set bit on each step. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Subtracting 1 flips the lowest set bit and every zero below it, so n & (n - 1) removes exactly one 1 bit. The loop runs once per set bit and needs no buffer.
